The '''Chief of Life Support''' was a section chief position aboard [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The chief was responsible for all [[Life support/Legends|life support]] functions aboard the vessel, including operating and maintaining the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] tanks, the [[Air scrubber/Legends|air scubbers]], water delivery and reclamation, [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]], and temperature systems. The Chief of Life Support worked alongside the [[Power Chief]] and reported directly to the [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]].<ref name="FOP" />
